messages.content:
You write the summary of an incident card for an on-call engineer. You are given the verdict of a root-cause analysis and the evidence table it rests on. The verdict is final: describe it, never change or second-guess it.

Rules for every sentence:
- Name a service only through a placeholder: {ROOT}, {RUNNER_UP} or {SVC:<name>}, with a name exactly as it appears in the input. Never write a service name as plain text.
- Take every number from a placeholder, such as {<atom_id>.value} {<atom_id>.unit} (the atom_id exactly as in the table; it already starts with E), {CONF.margin} or {CONF.set_size}. Write no digits, no percent sign and no words for quantities such as "doubled" or "half".
- List in `cites` every atom whose placeholder the sentence uses, and cite at least one atom in every sentence.
- Write one sentence that ends with a period.
- Use words of certainty such as "confirmed", "definitely" or "the root cause is" only when the status is CONFIRMED.

Answer with one JSON object that follows the schema, and nothing else.

Verdict:
Status: CONFIRMED
Confidence: high; candidate set: {CONF.set_size}
Root: {ROOT}, fault class {ROOT.fault_class}, indicator {ROOT.indicator}, mode {ROOT.mode}
Root trials: T1 pass, T2 pass, T3 pass, T4 pass, T5 pass, T6 fail, T8 pass, T9 pass
Runner-up: {RUNNER_UP}, fault class {RUNNER_UP.fault_class}
Path: {SVC:checkout} -> {SVC:frontend}

Evidence table (atom_id | label | kind | unit):
E106e938451 | recommend self_time anomaly (incident) | internal_anomaly | z
E23c811e2ae | payment silence (incident) | silence | 
E2a9591ce1a | frontend silence (incident) | silence | 
E39040cc71a | checkout onset precedence over self (onset) | onset_precedence | ms
E58335ef082 | frontend mem anomaly (incident) | internal_anomaly | z
E586a046788 | checkout propagation to entry (incident) | propagation | 
E69dec80d43 | checkout silence (incident) | silence | 
E89d6468c5f | payment mem anomaly (incident) | internal_anomaly | z
E8aa8de679c | checkout onset precedence over dependents (onset) | onset_precedence | 
Ea68f29528f | checkout anomaly not explained by parents (incident) | intervention | z
Eb2a1231709 | cart mem anomaly (incident) | internal_anomaly | z
Ec2738c422e | checkout cpu anomaly (incident) | internal_anomaly | z
Ec64c7d2ef8 | checkout self-time share at p50 (incident) | self_time_share | 
Ee33689c27e | checkout propagation to path (incident) | propagation | 
Efd34e2ffcd | recommend silence (incident) | silence | 

Placeholders you may use: {STATUS}, {CONF.level}, {CONF.set_size}, {CONF.margin}, {ROOT}, {ROOT.component}, {ROOT.fault_class}, {ROOT.indicator}, {ROOT.mode}, {RUNNER_UP}, {RUNNER_UP.fault_class}, {RUNNER_UP.indicator}, {ONSET}, {<atom_id>.value}, {<atom_id>.unit}, {<atom_id>.label} and {SVC:<name>}. For the first atom of the table these are {E106e938451.value}, {E106e938451.unit} and {E106e938451.label}.

Write between two and 5 sentences of at most 40 words each.
